function.name: impl_from_HSTRING
function.description: This function casts a given HSTRING to a hstring_private structure pointer.

parameters.name: string
parameters.description: This parameter is the HSTRING that needs to be cast to a hstring_private structure pointer.

function.return_type: struct hstring_private pointer, representing the cast HSTRING.

function.name: impl_from_HSTRING_HEADER
function.description: This function returns a pointer to a hstring_private structure that contains the given HSTRING_HEADER.

parameters.name: header
parameters.description: Pointer to a HSTRING_HEADER structure.

function.return_type: struct hstring_private *; Represents a pointer to a hstring_private structure.

function.name: impl_from_HSTRING_BUFFER
function.description: This function returns a pointer to the hstring_private structure that contains the given HSTRING_BUFFER.

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: This parameter is an HSTRING_BUFFER that is contained within a hstring_private structure.

function.return_type: struct hstring_private pointer, which represents the hstring_private structure that contains the given HSTRING_BUFFER.

function.name: alloc_string
function.description: This function allocates memory for a string and initializes the string structure.

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: The length of the string to be allocated.

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: A pointer to the string structure to be initialized.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the memory allocation and initialization was successful, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: WindowsCreateString
function.description: This function creates a new string and assigns it to the output pointer. It handles various edge cases such as null pointers and zero length.

parameters.name: ptr
parameters.description: Pointer to the wide-character string.

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: Length of the string to be created.

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: Pointer to the output string.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the output pointer is null, E_POINTER if the input string pointer is null, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if the string allocation fails.

function.name: WindowsCreateStringReference
function.description: This function creates a reference to a string. It checks for valid arguments and sets the string reference and its length in the header. If the length is zero, it sets the output to NULL. If the pointer to the string is NULL, it returns an error.

parameters.name: ptr
parameters.description: Pointer to the string to reference

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: Length of the string to reference

parameters.name: header
parameters.description: Pointer to the header where the string reference and its length will be set

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: Output parameter where the HSTRING reference will be set

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the arguments are invalid, and E_POINTER if the string pointer is NULL

function.name: WindowsDeleteString
function.description: This function deletes a Windows string by freeing the memory if the reference count is zero.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: The Windows string to be deleted.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful.

function.name: WindowsDuplicateString
function.description: This function duplicates a Windows string, handling reference counting and error conditions.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: The original string to be duplicated.

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the duplicate string will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the 'out' parameter is NULL, and may also return other error codes from the WindowsCreateString function.

function.name: WindowsPreallocateStringBuffer
function.description: This function preallocates a string buffer for Windows. It checks for null pointers and zero length, handles memory allocation, and sets the output pointers.

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: The length of the string to be allocated

parameters.name: outptr
parameters.description: Pointer to the output string buffer

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: Pointer to the output HSTRING buffer

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_POINTER if the pointers are null, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if the memory allocation fails.

function.name: WindowsDeleteStringBuffer
function.description: This function deletes a string buffer in a Windows environment.

parameters.name: buf
parameters.description: This is the string buffer that is to be deleted.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. Otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.name: WindowsPromoteStringBuffer
function.description: This function promotes a string buffer to a HSTRING. It checks for null pointers and invalid arguments before assigning the buffer to the output HSTRING.

parameters.name: buf
parameters.description: The string buffer to be promoted to a HSTRING.

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: Pointer to a HSTRING where the promoted string buffer will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_POINTER if the 'out' parameter is null, and E_INVALIDARG if the buffer is invalid.

function.name: WindowsGetStringLen
function.description: This function returns the length of a Windows HSTRING.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: This is the HSTRING whose length is to be determined.

function.return_type: UINT32, represents the length of the input HSTRING. If the input is NULL, it returns 0.

function.name: WindowsGetStringRawBuffer
function.description: This function retrieves the raw string buffer from a Windows HSTRING and optionally returns its length.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: The HSTRING from which to retrieve the raw string buffer.

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: Optional. If provided, this will be set to the length of the string.

function.return_type: LPCWSTR. This is a pointer to the raw string buffer in the HSTRING. If the HSTRING is NULL, this will point to an empty string.

function.name: WindowsStringHasEmbeddedNull
function.description: This function checks if a Windows string (HSTRING) has an embedded null character. If it does, it sets the out parameter to TRUE, otherwise it sets it to FALSE.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: The Windows string to check for an embedded null character.

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: A pointer to a BOOL variable. The function sets this to TRUE if the string has an embedded null character, and to FALSE otherwise.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the out parameter is NULL, it returns E_INVALIDARG. If the str parameter is NULL, it sets out to FALSE and returns S_OK.

function.name: WindowsSubstring
function.description: This function creates a substring from a given string starting from a specified index.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: The original string from which a substring is to be created.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The starting index from where the substring is to be created.

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: Pointer to the output substring.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the output pointer is NULL, and E_BOUNDS if the start index is greater than the length of the string.

function.name: WindowsSubstringWithSpecifiedLength
function.description: This function creates a substring of a specified length from a given start position of a Windows string.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: The original Windows string from which the substring is to be created.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The starting position in the string where the substring should begin.

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: The length of the substring to be created.

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: A pointer to the output variable where the created substring will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the output pointer is NULL, and E_BOUNDS if the start position and length result in a range outside the original string.

function.name: WindowsConcatString
function.description: This function concatenates two HSTRINGs and returns the result in a third HSTRING. If any of the input strings is NULL, it duplicates the other string. If both strings are empty, it returns NULL. If memory allocation fails, it returns an error.

parameters.name: str1
parameters.description: The first string to concatenate

parameters.name: str2
parameters.description: The second string to concatenate

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: Pointer to the output string where the result of the concatenation is stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the output string pointer is NULL, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, or the result of WindowsDuplicateString if one of the input strings is NULL.

function.name: WindowsIsStringEmpty
function.description: This function checks if a given string is empty or not.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: The string to be checked for emptiness

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the string is empty, otherwise returns FALSE

function.name: WindowsCompareStringOrdinal
function.description: This function compares two HSTRINGs and returns the result in res. It returns a HRESULT indicating success or failure.

parameters.name: str1
parameters.description: The first string to compare

parameters.name: str2
parameters.description: The second string to compare

parameters.name: res
parameters.description: Pointer to an integer where the result of the comparison is stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, where S_OK indicates success and E_INVALIDARG indicates that res is NULL

function.name: WindowsTrimStringStart
function.description: This function trims the start of the first string (str1) based on the characters present in the second string (str2) and stores the result in the output string (out).

parameters.name: str1
parameters.description: The original string to be trimmed.

parameters.name: str2
parameters.description: The string containing characters based on which str1 will be trimmed.

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: Pointer to the output string where the result will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and E_INVALIDARG if the input arguments are not valid.

function.name: WindowsTrimStringEnd
function.description: This function trims the end of the first string (str1) by removing any characters that are present in the second string (str2). The result is stored in the output parameter (out).

parameters.name: str1
parameters.description: The string to be trimmed.

parameters.name: str2
parameters.description: The string containing characters to be removed from the end of str1.

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: Pointer to the output parameter where the result will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if any of the input arguments is invalid, or other error codes as defined by the Windows API.
